author: Unity
description:
The Unity command-line interface (CLI) turns the Editor into a local command server. This package lets a terminal, an agent, or a custom interface connect and run commands directly. In this video, you’ll learn how to install the Unity CLI and how to use the CLI command surface -  including Play mode control, recompiles, running tests, custom commands, and the built-in eval function for executing C# in a live Unity instance.
